استحمروا (form X)
# اِسْتَحْمَرُوا (istaḥmarū) /is.taħ.ma.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَحْمَرَ (istaḥmara)
# اُسْتُحْمِرُوا (ustuḥmirū) /us.tuħ.mi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَحْمَرَ (istaḥmara)
# اِسْتَحْمِرُوا (istaḥmirū) /is.taħ.mi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَحْمَرَ (istaḥmara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
